Job Summary

Infyni is hiring an Agentic AI Engineer for one of our end clients for a full-time role in Bangalore. The selected candidate will be employed on the end clients payroll. The client name will remain confidential during the hiring process.

Key Skills
Strong hands-on experience with Python and agent execution loops.
Expertise in tool calling, state and memory management, retries, and checkpoints.
Experience with sandboxing and secure agent execution.
Familiarity with LangGraph, MCP, OpenHands, observability, and context engineering.
Requirements
Experience: 2-4 years.
Location: Bangalore.
Work mode: Onsite.
Job type: Full-time.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
